on_this_day.title: UNESCO is founded
on_this_day.summary: UNESCO’s Constitution was signed in London on 16 November 1945. Its name stands for the United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization. The organisation was created to support cooperation through education, science and culture. Its Constitution entered into force the following year. The anniversary is a chance to think about how schools, scientific knowledge and cultural exchange can contribute to understanding between people and countries.
